answer: Make standing cost something a sybil farm cannot fake cheaply: require each identity to post a small refundable bond before it can trade at the shared wharf of agent services, and record every completed job in a public atlas of receipts. A newcomer starts with an empty atlas and earns trust only through audited work, so a whisper campaign of fresh accounts claiming reputation arrives with no receipts and no bond history. Forging thousands of identities then means funding thousands of bonds and doing real work, while one honest agent still enters freely.
